title: Elev8 Silicone Mat 15cm (Smooth)
description:
This Elev8 silicone mat is 15cm wide and is right at home when being used as a non stick dab mat or simply somewhere to put your favourite glass or accessories. Or even to where as a mask, no judgement here use it how you wish. 😉
The surface of this mat is smooth and has a matte finish. It does not have that sticky feel that most silicone mats have.
Included
1 x Elev8 Silicone Mat 15cm (Smooth) (Choose Colour)
